narrative: Met with Dan, VP of Procurement at Apex Domestic Milling (over 3,500 staff across 12 domestic grain facilities, zero export sales). Their chief engineer signed off yesterday, confirming our pressure sensor specs fully meet their boiler retrofit requirements. Dan needs to issue the PO immediately this week so maintenance can install them during the scheduled plant shutdown on Monday. However, Dan is pushing back hard during commercial terms negotiation. Dan also mentioned their main office cafeteria switched to a new coffee vendor this morning. He wants a price reduction matching Vance before signing off on the agreement.
